kitDescription: Mica is a Wind-element rocket-launcher Supporter occupying the Burst-I slot. Her skill 1 would raise her own DEF after she takes 20 hits, but the sim's boss never attacks, so that line never comes into play. Every 20 seconds her skill 2 grants the two allies with the highest final ATK a +2-round magazine extension and a DEF buff, each lasting 10 seconds — the extra rounds mean fewer reloads and more firing uptime for those two carries. Her burst deals 152.22% of her final ATK to all enemies (a single hit on the test boss) and would lower enemy DEF by 13.32% for 5 seconds; that debuff is honestly unmodeled because the sim has no debuff-scalable boss-DEF channel, so her comps read slightly cold by that small team-wide lift. She is otherwise a pure support whose only damage lever is the ammo extension she hands out.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA exists: all five kit lines are either FAITHFUL (S2 ammo flat-round grant, S2 DEF grant, burst nuke) or DOCUMENTED_GAP with verbatim unmodeled entries and ⚑ estimate+recipe+tier (S1 attacked-20× — no incoming-damage channel; burst DEF▼ — no debuff-scalable boss-DEF channel). The two blind re-derivations converged completely: S6's override is behaviorally identical to the driver's on every line (cosmetic/provenance differences only, with the driver holding better provenance on the datamined 20s skill CD), and S5's blind tests run 15/15 green with 2 skips that are the author's own documented GAPs on the same two lines the driver holds unmodeled — convergence is mechanical, not asserted. Discrimination is strong: 13 counterfactual arms each pinned RED (attacks-misread hitCount:20, passive duty cycle, all-allies scope, lowest-2 rank swap, maxAmmoPct percent-misread, atkPct def-misread, lvl-1 magnitude, fullBurstEnter timing, damageTakenPct laundering, plus removals and encoding pins), and the load-bearing ammo line is proven live via magazine-size (8-round mags), refill-size, and recipient-total assertions. The single adapted S5 assertion (net-sign → movement + one-sided lift) is a fixture-dynamics accommodation with the substance preserved and the clean form pinned in driver M4 — not a divergence. Ranked residuals for the owner: (1) the burst DEF▼ gap means mica comps read cold by a small team-wide lift (at boss DEF≈140, ~13.32% DEF cut at ~25% uptime — negligible per the SSOT's own ≤0.12% DEF-materiality note, but real); (2) the S2 interval:20 cadence is datamine-sourced, not footage-pinned — same-model stability risk is low given three independent derivations, but the interval first-fire phase (t=20s vs t=0) remains an engine-native convention worth a popup-cadence read if an S2 consumer is ever measured; (3) the sole-B1 fixture is sound, but the owner should spot-check that the byFinalAtk live-ranking behaves correctly in comps where an ATK buff re-ranks the pool mid-fight (the driver fixture deliberately holds the ranking static).
